title: Lyria 3.5 brings more controllable AI music generation to Google Flow Music
friendlyTitle: Google’s new music AI gives creators more control
summary: Google released Lyria 3.5 in Flow Music with improvements to melody, lyrics, vocal expression and pronunciation. New controls also let creators set tempo and duration more directly.
friendlySummary: Lyria 3.5 can make richer music, clearer lyrics and more natural voices. Users can also control the song’s speed and length more easily.
whyItMatters: The update moves music generation toward an editable creative instrument rather than a one-shot novelty. Musicians, video teams and small businesses can prototype tracks faster, although final work still needs human taste and rights-aware review.
friendlyWhyItMatters: Creators can test music ideas quickly and then choose what to keep or change. Human review is still important before publishing the result.
